title: Law to protect whistleblowers reporting AI safety risks
summary: This bill would extend New York City's whistleblower protections to city employees and city contractor employees who report AI-related conduct they believe poses a substantial risk to public health or safety. City contractors and subcontractors would have to post notices at work sites about these whistleblower protections. The Department of Investigation would have to include the number of AI-related whistleblower reports in its annual report to the mayor and Council speaker.
